exercise_name: Dust In The Wind · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《Dust in the Wind》描寫生命短暫、時間無情流逝，以及世間萬物終將消逝的深刻感慨。歌中的主角閉上雙眼，回望曾經擁有的夢想與經歷，卻發現一切都如風中的塵埃，轉瞬即逝。他將人類的存在比喻為無垠大海中的一滴水，提醒我們無論擁有多少財富、成就與榮耀，最終都無法阻止時間流逝。歌曲亦勸勉人們放下對物質與永恆的執著，學會接受生命的無常。最終，《Dust in the Wind》傳達的是對生命、時間與存在意義的哲學反思：人生雖然短暫，所有事物也終將消逝，但正因時光無法挽回，我們更應珍惜當下，珍視生命中真正重要的人與事。

vocabulary.usage: 想表示某件事情只持續很短的時間，可以用 for a moment。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「for a moment」？
options: The shop sells three moments for five dollars.
I waited for a moment, and then the door opened.
Please put the moment in the fridge before it gets hot.
My uncle is a moment because he is very busy.
optionExplanations: moment 在這裡指片刻，不是商店能按個數販售的商品；若要說賣三個蘋果，可說 The shop sells three apples for five dollars.
我等了一小會兒，門就開了；for a moment 正確表示短暫的時間。
片刻不是會變熱、需要冷藏的食物；可說 Please put the milk in the fridge.
a moment 不是「忙碌的人」的稱呼；可說 My uncle is very busy.
vocabulary.explanation: 我等了一小會兒，門就開了；for a moment 正確表示短暫的時間。

vocabulary.meaning: 從我眼前掠過；（回憶、畫面）在腦中一一浮現。
vocabulary.usage: 描述景象在眼前經過，或許多回憶在腦海中快速出現時使用。這個片語比一般 A2 表達更富畫面感。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「pass before my eyes」？
options: The doctor passed my eyes because I was late.
I pass before my eyes when I want to wear glasses.
The train passed before my eyes an exam and got a gold medal.
Old memories pass before my eyes when I look at these photos.
optionExplanations: 這個片語不是醫生替眼睛做檢查的說法；可說 The doctor checked my eyes.
pass before my eyes 不能表示戴眼鏡；可說 I put on my glasses when I want to see better.
句子把「從眼前經過」和「通過考試」兩種 pass 的意思混在一起；可說 The train passed in front of me.
看著照片時，往事一幕幕浮現，符合片語的比喻用法。
vocabulary.explanation: 看著照片時，往事一幕幕浮現，符合片語的比喻用法。

vocabulary.usage: 描述桌上、地上或空氣中的細小灰塵時使用；在歌曲中也可象徵事物的短暫。
options: I sent some dust an email, but it did not reply.
The museum says its dust is the new manager.
The weather report says dust will be president tomorrow.
There is dust on this old shelf. Let's clean it.
optionExplanations: 灰塵沒有電子郵件帳號，也不能回信；可說 I sent my friend an email, but she did not reply.
灰塵不是能擔任經理的人；可說 The museum has a new manager.
天氣預報可能談空氣中的灰塵，但灰塵不能當總統；可說 The weather report says it will be windy tomorrow.
舊架子上有灰塵，應該清理，dust 的意思正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 舊架子上有灰塵，應該清理，dust 的意思正確。

vocabulary.usage: 指非常少量的水，也可以用來比喻某件事在龐大事物中顯得很小。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「a drop of water」？
options: One drop of water fell from the tap.
The hotel gave me a drop of water as my room key.
My cousin studied a drop of water for six years and became a table.
A drop of water called the fire department because it was lonely.
optionExplanations: 水龍頭滴下一滴水，是 a drop of water 的正確用法。
水滴不能充當房間鑰匙；可說 The hotel gave me a key to my room.
學習多年也不會變成桌子；a drop of water 在這裡完全不合語意。可說 My cousin studied science for six years.
水滴不能因為寂寞就打電話報警或求助；可說 The child called the fire department when he saw a fire.
vocabulary.explanation: 水龍頭滴下一滴水，是 a drop of water 的正確用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 無盡的、似乎沒有盡頭的。
vocabulary.usage: 形容道路、海洋、等待或事情很長，彷彿沒有終點時使用。
options: The meeting felt endless. We sat there for hours.
I endless my jacket before leaving home.
My new endless is sleeping under the sofa.
The waiter gave us an endless plate, so we could not find its end.
optionExplanations: 會議開了好幾個小時，感覺沒完沒了，使用自然。
endless 不是動詞，不能表示穿外套；可說 I put on my jacket before leaving home.
endless 是形容詞，不是會躺在沙發下的東西；可說 My cat is sleeping under the sofa.
這句硬把 endless 當作盤子沒有邊緣的特殊規格，並非一般描述用餐器具的自然說法；可說 The waiter gave us a large plate.
vocabulary.explanation: 會議開了好幾個小時，感覺沒完沒了，使用自然。

vocabulary.usage: 描述餅乾、老牆或其他東西碎裂；也能比喻計畫或希望瓦解。這個字略高於一般 A2 字彙。
options: The library crumbled my name and gave it to another reader.
This old cookie may crumble when you pick it up.
I crumble at seven o'clock because the alarm is loud.
The captain crumbled the sea to find his ship.
optionExplanations: 圖書館不會把名字「碎裂」後交給別人；可說 The library gave my card to another reader by mistake.
舊餅乾可能一拿就碎，符合 crumble 的意思。
不能用 crumble 表示起床；可說 I wake up at seven o'clock because the alarm is loud.
crumble 表示碎裂，不是搜尋大海；可說 The captain searched the sea for his ship.
vocabulary.explanation: 舊餅乾可能一拿就碎，符合 crumble 的意思。

vocabulary.meaning: 拒絕做某事、不願意做某事。
vocabulary.usage: 明確表示不肯做某個動作時，使用 refuse to + 原形動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「refuse to」？
options: She refused to sign the paper because she did not agree.
The clock refused to be Tuesday, so the office stayed on Monday.
The elevator refused to the fifth floor a new job.
I refuse to a sandwich because it is raining.
optionExplanations: 因為不同意而拒絕簽名，結構與意思都正確。
時鐘不能自行決定今天是星期幾；這是把 refuse 當成能改變日曆的權力。可說 The clock stopped, so I checked the time on my phone.
電梯不能把樓層當作新工作；可說 The elevator refused to move.（例如故障時的擬人說法）
refuse to 後面需要動詞原形；若要說拒絕吃東西，可說 I refuse to eat the sandwich.
vocabulary.explanation: 因為不同意而拒絕簽名，結構與意思都正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 抓緊；堅持不放手；（口語）等一下。
vocabulary.usage: 請人稍等，或描述抓住、緊抓某物時使用；歌曲的語境偏向「不要再執著」。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「hang on」？
options: Our town hangs on a cloud, but only on weekends.
Please hang on the soup until it learns to swim.
Hang on a minute. I need to find my keys.
The bank said my money must hang on the wall for three days.
optionExplanations: 城鎮不會只在週末掛在雲上；可說 Our town is in the mountains.
湯不是能學游泳的東西，hang on 在此也沒有合理的動作對象；可說 Please wait until the soup is cool.
Hang on a minute 是請對方等一下的常見口語說法。
hang on 不能表示銀行暫時保管金錢，更不需要把錢掛在牆上；可說 The bank will keep my money for three days.
vocabulary.explanation: Hang on a minute 是請對方等一下的常見口語說法。

vocabulary.usage: 想說某件事永遠存在，或用否定句表達「不會永遠持續」時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「last forever」？
options: The shop sells forever in small blue boxes.
The final exam lasted forever because the principal lost the calendar.
This ice cream will not last forever in the sun.
I last forever my bicycle when it rains.
optionExplanations: forever 是時間概念，不是商店能裝盒販售的貨品；可說 The shop sells small blue boxes.
就算校長弄丟日曆，考試也不會因此真的永遠持續；若要表示感覺很久，可說 The final exam felt very long.
冰淇淋在陽光下不會永遠保持原狀，will not last forever 使用自然。
last forever 不是修理或騎腳踏車的動作；可說 I ride my bicycle when it is sunny.
vocabulary.explanation: 冰淇淋在陽光下不會永遠保持原狀，will not last forever 使用自然。

vocabulary.usage: 描述人悄悄離開，或時間、機會在沒有注意到時流逝。這個片語的比喻用法稍高於一般 A2。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「slip away」？
options: I slipped away the door with a new blue paint.
Time can slip away when you are having fun.
The report said Friday slipped away from the week and moved to another country.
The city slipped away its new law because the paper was wet.
optionExplanations: slip away 不是幫門刷油漆；可說 I painted the door blue.
玩得開心時時間不知不覺流逝，符合片語的比喻用法。
星期五不會離開一週，搬到另一個國家；可說 Friday is the last school day of the week for many students.
slip away 不能直接接 its new law 作受詞，也不是撤回法律的說法；可說 The city changed its new law.
vocabulary.context: 教學提醒：：先讓學生說明為什麼錯誤選項不合用法，再展開答案。錯誤句子的笑點有時來自字義混淆，有時來自把時間、日期或抽象概念當成可以買賣、搬家、任職的東西；解說應保持簡潔、平實，不必刻意解釋笑話。歌曲中 dust in the wind、endless sea 等意象具有哲學意味，例句則刻意用較簡單的生活情境幫學生理解字詞。
vocabulary.explanation: 玩得開心時時間不知不覺流逝，符合片語的比喻用法。
